capability: v=linspace(-vmax,vmax,nv+1); df=.1 exp(-v^2); E=i dv sum(df)/k.
operation: velocity window, mode count and k -> Poisson-closed df and E
discovery.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
discovery.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
discovery.boundary: Finite uniform velocity window and discrete Poisson closure; fixed ion background; state construction only.

identity.relation: v=linspace(-vmax,vmax,nv+1); df=.1 exp(-v^2); E=i dv sum(df)/k.
identity.definition: v=linspace(-vmax,vmax,nv+1); f0' from the built-in family Fn or the caller's df0dv (Fn=None); df=df_initial, default .1 exp(-v^2); E=i dv sum(df)/k.
identity.model: Linear one-dimensional single-spatial-Fourier-mode electrons, fixed ions.
identity.geometry: One velocity coordinate and one spatial Fourier mode.
identity.boundary: Finite uniform velocity window and discrete Poisson closure; fixed ion background; state construction only.
assumptions: Velocity-window truncation and recurrence are separate from temporal integration error.

inputs.name: Fn
inputs.description: Built-in equilibrium, unit density: 1 Maxwellian exp(-v^2/2)/sqrt(2pi) (unit variance); 2 kappa Gamma(kappa)/(Gamma(kappa-1/2) sqrt(2 pi kappa)) (1+v^2/(2 kappa))^-kappa, i.e. theta^2=2 with variance 2kappa/(2kappa-3), NOT unit temperature; 3 triangle max(0,1-|v|); 4 cutoff slowing-down.
inputs.constraints: One of 1,2,3,4, or None together with df0dv.

inputs.name: kappa
inputs.description: Kappa index of the Fn=2 family. The family is not rescaled to unit variance; for a kappa distribution at a prescribed temperature pass its derivative as df0dv to vp_init.

inputs.name: dt
inputs.description: Time step in inverse plasma frequency.

inputs.name: nt
inputs.description: Exact number of ordered time steps.

inputs.name: k
inputs.description: Spatial Fourier wavenumber in inverse Debye length.

inputs.name: df_initial
inputs.description: Initial perturbation df(v,0) on vv=linspace(-vmax,vmax,nv+1). Default 0.1*exp(-v^2), a fixed Gaussian in grid velocity units, not proportional to f0.
inputs.constraints: Finite, one value per velocity node; None selects the default.

inputs.name: df0dv
inputs.description: Custom equilibrium derivative f0'(v) on vv, used instead of a built-in family; requires Fn=None.
inputs.constraints: Finite, real, one value per velocity node; given exactly when Fn is None.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: State mapping: Fn,kappa,nv,dt,nt,k,vmax,vmin,dv,TR; vv,df,df0dv [nv+1]; scalar dE; dEt,tt [nt+1]; wr,wi are kappa=1 theory or None. Fields and arrays are independently owned.
outputs.shape: As described in output mapping or tuple.
outputs.constraints: State mapping with finite arrays and an initial field satisfying discrete Poisson closure.

preconditions: Fn, kappa, nv, dt, nt, k and vmax satisfy the declared scalar domains.
supported: Finite velocity-grid initialization with discrete Poisson-consistent dE and empty or finite-length time history.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: ValueError for invalid scalar controls or a distribution branch that rejects the selected parameters.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: FloatingPointError if the generated derivative or Poisson field is not finite.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Not applicable; initialization has no iteration.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No state is returned after an exception.

python.signature: vp_init(Fn=2, kappa=1.0, nv=2048, dt=0.01, nt=2000, *, k=0.15, vmax=20.0, df_initial=None, df0dv=None)

example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.vlasov_poisson import vp_init
s=vp_init(nv=32,nt=5)
assert s["df"].shape == (33,)
example.description: Build a Poisson-consistent 32-interval initial state with five time steps.

scope: Discrete Poisson constraint and off-diagonal rank-one feedback.
Dense matrix-exponential RK4 order; analytic free-streaming and damped-cosine diagnostics.
Slowing-down weak derivative integration-by-parts and default 2049-node/2000-step execution.

A custom df0dv/df_initial pair equal to the built-in Maxwellian and default perturbation reproduces its field history; arrays off the grid, Fn given with df0dv, or Fn=None without it raise ValueError.
verification.evidence_ceiling: Independent semidiscrete mathematical and selected scenario regressions; actual run/installed-wheel receipts are recorded separately, not inferred from test existence.
known_limitations: Finite-window rectangle rule and sampling recurrence TR=2pi/(k*dv).
Fn4 truncated density retains original coefficient and is not renormalized after cutoff.
Peak diagnostic assumes standing oscillation; rotating complex exponential has no amplitude peaks.
